next.reason: 1985: "If more than one argument-1 is specified, all arguments must be of the same class."; 2023: "with the exception that mixing of arguments of alphabetic and alphanumeric classes is allowed.". Both require all ORD-MAX arguments to be of one class, but 2023 adds an exception: alphabetic and alphanumeric arguments may be mixed, which 1985 refused.
